reviews.title: Great app, but needs a "Not sure" option
reviews.text:
I really enjoy using this app, but I have one suggestion for the quiz mode.
Please consider adding a "Not sure" option. Currently, I sometimes guess the correct answer by luck, which prevents me from actually learning the word.
Please also let's practice words that we struggle with in flashcard mode to retain them efficiently. Also adding images will illustrating the meanings way better.
Thanks for your continued improvements!

reviews.title: Mastery is too Easy
reviews.text:
I initially really enjoyed this app because I felt like I was genuinely learning new words. However, when I looked through the list of words I had supposedly “mastered,” I realized that I couldn’t recall the definitions of many of them.

I think the synonym-matching system is a little too easy, especially because many of the other synonym options are words I’ve never encountered before. This makes it easy to choose the correct answer based on visual familiarity rather than actually knowing the word. As a result, I feel like my “mastery” of a word can sometimes be based on recognizing the answer rather than truly understanding it.

Because of this, I think it would be helpful to add another step before a word can be considered “mastered.” What seems to work best for me is the sentence-completion game because it requires me to actually use the word in context, which I think is necessary to genuinely say that I know a word.

I also have a suggestion for the sentence-completion game itself. I don’t find it as constructive to see a list of all the answers I got right or wrong at the end, because it doesn’t give me the opportunity to reinforce each word individually. I think that, regardless of whether you get an answer right or wrong, the next screen should show the definition of the word you were looking for as a refresher, similar to how the synonym game works. I also wouldn’t mind seeing the definitions of the other incorrect options, as that could help reinforce those words as well.

If these changes were implemented, I would genuinely be a customer for life. Other than that, I highly enjoy the app and think it has a lot of potential.
